blocks.task_summary: Find the value of a car after ten years given initial value €30,000 and annual depreciation of 15%, to two decimal places.
accepted_alternatives: Use GDC TVM solver with PV=30000, I%=15, P/Y=1, C/Y=1, N=10, compute FV.

blocks.task_summary: Find the number of months for the real value of an investment of €50,000 to first exceed €55,000, given monthly compound interest of 1.5% and monthly inflation of 0.8%.
method_path: Calculate real monthly interest rate: r = 1.5 - 0.8 = 0.7%
Round up to next integer: 14 months

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: r = 1.5 - 0.8 = 0.7% (A1); attempt to substitute into inequality (M1); 50000(1 + 0.7/100)^n > 55000; correct critical value n=13.6633... OR crossover values n=13 (€54746.09), n=14 (€55129.31) (A1); 14 months A1. METHOD 2: (1+1.5/100)/(1+0.8/100) = 1.00694... (A1); attempt inequality (M1); 50000(1.00694...)^n > 55000; critical value n=13.7722... OR crossover values n=13 (€54706.84), n=14 (€55086.75) (A1); 14 months A1.
